text:
maya: Heads-up: found case where reconnect after ephemeral toolcall leaves trailing tokens billed to user even though toolcall was truncated by client. Repro on staging with session_id 'ephem-rt-42'.

oli: Can you paste the logs / request ids? sounds like previous 'ghost suffix' but maybe different

maya: logs: ```2026-03-18T12:34:56Z request=rt-ephem-42 path=/stream toolcall_id=tc-891 truncated=true eof=true reconnect_after_ms=200``` Also ledger shows tokens attributed to toolcall after reconnect. I think the handoff didn't clear suffix buffer.

jia: Is this during fallback routing? Or same shard?

maya: Same shard, no fallback. It's a reconnect resume where client reopens stream and we replay ack window. The client acked EOF but then sends new init that replays previous last_chunk. Looks like provisional credits were confirmed on ack; but when reconnect appended suffix the ledger double-counted.

ron: @billing-bot any ledger entries?

billing-bot: billing-bot: provisional charge created for tc-891 (15 tokens). Finalized at 2026-03-18T12:34:58Z. Later session rt-ephem-42 had 12 suffix tokens billed under replayed chunk.

oli: So cause could be: provisional finalization race + replayed chunk attribution. Proposal: change finalization to wait 250ms after EOF if reconnect_window open, or add client-side idempotency tag for toolcall finalization.

maya: I prefer server-side: tag toolcall as 'final' only when we see terminal ACK with no immediate reconnect within grace window. 250ms seems arbitrary. We should also emit a console metric 'toolcall_finalization_race' and show per-route incidence.

jia: Agree on metric + dashboard. Ops: add a quick guard in router to dedupe duplicate suffixes based on (session_id, toolcall_id, suffix_hash) ASAP.

oli: I'll open a PR for router dedupe + metric. @maya can you add a tiny repro script and include event ids? I'll coordinate with billing to run a backfill.

maya: On it. PR/issue in #eng-platform soon. :thumbsup:
